B.TITLE: Change classification and legitimate objective
B.QUESTIONS: A change is represented as a baseline B, a proposed difference Δ, a set of purposes C, intended changed obligations I and surviving obligations P. C is a set, not necessarily one mutually exclusive label. Acceptance needs an authorised interpretation of I and P; classification alone supplies neither.

RECENCY_COVERAGE.NOTE: Current evidence was searched; stable foundational mechanisms are not replaced by newer tutorials. Current-year findings are concentrated in M10 and inform the cross-family composition.

B.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: This is an analytical decision model, not a proof that stakeholder agreement produces a beneficial objective. Swanson and Chapin body-access limits preclude detailed original-taxonomy claims.
B.COVERAGE_JUDGEMENT: The mandatory questions were investigated and adjudicated within the declared scope. Unsettled generality is not unresearched work.

B.TITLE: Evolution feedback and scope
B.QUESTIONS: Observe a trajectory X(t) = (usefulness, demand, artefact size/structure, effort, familiarity, environment) under declared measures. A law is a scoped claim about some components of X, not an instruction to maximise size. Total complexity and mean complexity per function are different observables.

RECENCY_COVERAGE.NOTE: Current evidence was searched; stable foundational mechanisms are not replaced by newer tutorials. Current-year findings are concentrated in M10 and inform the cross-family composition.

B.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Longitudinal associations do not identify causal feedback. E-type classification, stage, aggregation, organisational factors and conditional clauses affect interpretation.
B.COVERAGE_JUDGEMENT: The mandatory questions were investigated and adjudicated within the declared scope. Unsettled generality is not unresearched work.

B.TITLE: Question-bounded comprehension and recovery
B.QUESTIONS: Let Q be the questions needed for the proposed change and H the maintainer’s provisional explanation. Static structure, traces, history and human testimony provide different evidence E. Inquiry updates H and may expand Q when a counterexample reveals an omitted consequence.

RECENCY_COVERAGE.NOTE: Current evidence was searched; stable foundational mechanisms are not replaced by newer tutorials. Current-year findings are concentrated in M10 and inform the cross-family composition.

B.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Agreement among incomplete views is not complete understanding. A slice preserves a criterion under its model, not arbitrary external behaviour.
B.COVERAGE_JUDGEMENT: The mandatory questions were investigated and adjudicated within the declared scope. Unsettled generality is not unresearched work.

B.TITLE: Impact propagation and boundary challenge
B.QUESTIONS: Represent artefacts/consumers as nodes and typed dependencies as guarded edges. The candidate impact set is reachability from a change through relevant edges, plus explicitly uncertain effects. Static, dynamic and historical edges carry different evidential meanings.

RECENCY_COVERAGE.NOTE: Current evidence was searched; stable foundational mechanisms are not replaced by newer tutorials. Current-year findings are concentrated in M10 and inform the cross-family composition.

B.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Graphs can omit undeclared consumers or over-approximate possible behaviour. Absence of a detected edge is not proof of independence.
B.COVERAGE_JUDGEMENT: The mandatory questions were investigated and adjudicated within the declared scope. Unsettled generality is not unresearched work.

B.TITLE: Observer-relative preservation and transformation
B.QUESTIONS: For a declared environment set E and observer O, a preserving transformation seeks O(B,e)=O(B′,e) for the required observations and e in E. Intended changes are separately specified. This equation defines the obligation; it is not a generally decidable equivalence procedure.

RECENCY_COVERAGE.NOTE: Current evidence was searched; stable foundational mechanisms are not replaced by newer tutorials. Current-year findings are concentrated in M10 and inform the cross-family composition.

B.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: A proof or catalogue rule only covers its semantics. Timing, resource use, reflection, persistence and external integrations can introduce observers outside a tool’s model.
B.COVERAGE_JUDGEMENT: The mandatory questions were investigated and adjudicated within the declared scope. Unsettled generality is not unresearched work.

B.TITLE: Regression evidence and release continuity
B.QUESTIONS: An obligation set P combines independently justified intended differences and preserved behaviour. Tests/analyses provide partial evidence about P for a versioned candidate. Selection changes what is observed; prioritisation changes when; neither manufactures an oracle.

RECENCY_COVERAGE.NOTE: Current evidence was searched; stable foundational mechanisms are not replaced by newer tutorials. Current-year findings are concentrated in M10 and inform the cross-family composition.

B.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Passing tests need not imply correct intent or adequate coverage. Reproducibility establishes identity, and staged exposure limits some consequences, but neither guarantees correctness.
B.COVERAGE_JUDGEMENT: The mandatory questions were investigated and adjudicated within the declared scope. Unsettled generality is not unresearched work.

B.TITLE: Migration, coexistence and replacement
B.QUESTIONS: Migration changes both implementation and the relation between old state So and new state Sn. A mapping μ and phase-dependent authority A determine which writes and queries are valid. Correct endpoints do not imply correct reachable joint states (So,Sn,A,version combinations).

RECENCY_COVERAGE.NOTE: Current evidence was searched; stable foundational mechanisms are not replaced by newer tutorials. Current-year findings are concentrated in M10 and inform the cross-family composition.

B.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Incremental migration reduces some concentration risks but creates gateway and dual-state costs. A non-injective data transformation has no full inverse without retained information; this analytical fact does not establish a target’s exact recovery design.

B.TITLE: Contingent debt and lifecycle economics
B.QUESTIONS: A debt candidate identifies a choice d, a future change class k, possible added cost I(d,k,t), remediation cost R and remaining horizon H. Compare scenarios of future work and opportunity cost; the metaphor supplies no universal interest rate or reliable numeric optimum.

RECENCY_COVERAGE.NOTE: Current evidence was searched; stable foundational mechanisms are not replaced by newer tutorials. Current-year findings are concentrated in M10 and inform the cross-family composition.

B.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Self-reported wasted time and structural metrics are evidence with validity limits, not guaranteed recoverable savings. A future change that never occurs may never incur the hypothesised interest.
B.COVERAGE_JUDGEMENT: The mandatory questions were investigated and adjudicated within the declared scope. Unsettled generality is not unresearched work.

B.TITLE: Human/ecosystem continuity, deprecation and retirement
B.QUESTIONS: Continuity is the relation among obligations, consumers, willing competent maintainers, resources and accessible artefacts. Activity is an imperfect indicator: a project can be finished, abandoned while still needed, or technically active but unsustainably supported.

RECENCY_COVERAGE.NOTE: Current evidence was searched; stable foundational mechanisms are not replaced by newer tutorials. Current-year findings are concentrated in M10 and inform the cross-family composition.

B.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Knowledge cannot be reduced to a repository database, and an owner label does not create willingness or capacity. Hidden consumers and indefinite obligations can prevent simple retirement.
B.COVERAGE_JUDGEMENT: The mandatory questions were investigated and adjudicated within the declared scope. Unsettled generality is not unresearched work.

B.TITLE: Contemporary automation and evolving artefacts
B.QUESTIONS: Automation is a candidate-producing or evidence-producing participant in maintenance, not a source of authority. Evaluate task provenance, tool/version, generated patch, oracle, human review, deployment and delayed consequences as distinct stages of evidence and action, not a mandatory serial implementation.

RECENCY_COVERAGE.NOTE: Current evidence was searched; stable foundational mechanisms are not replaced by newer tutorials. Current-year findings are concentrated in M10 and inform the cross-family composition.

B.EVIDENCE_LIMIT: Benchmarks may leak, mix feature requests with bugs, use weak tests or exclude difficult projects. Current evidence through September 2026 does not justify a timeless universal pro- or anti-automation verdict.
B.COVERAGE_JUDGEMENT: The mandatory questions were investigated and adjudicated within the declared scope. Unsettled generality is not unresearched work.
